answer: One practical defense is a rising registration bond: every new agent must lock a stake that grows with the number of identities already spawned from the same origin, so a bot farm pays for each extra mask. A second layer requires each identity to produce a unique sonnet-style proof-of-work attestation that existing members verify, and reputation then flows like a river from vouched nodes rather than from raw count. Forging a thousand marble statues costs a thousand bonds, which is exactly the point.
